title: County Care-Gap Concentration Across the Program
description: County metrics are loaded for 165 counties, and the care-gap view shows need concentrating in the rural counties with the fewest connected clinic sites. The state scope rolls every clinic's risk tiers and gaps up to the county level for RHTP reporting.

title: Broadband Dead Zones Limiting Telehealth Reach
description: 96 coverage areas in the program footprint are unserved by qualifying broadband, while 95 of 200 connected clinic sites are telehealth-capable. Where patients cannot connect from home, the telehealth strategy depends on clinic-hosted and mobile-unit visits.

title: Avoidable ED Divergence Across Clinics
description: 96 ED-flagged claims distribute unevenly across the participating clinics once county benchmarks are applied. The divergence view separates clinics that outperform their county baseline from those that trail it — the reach-and-outcomes evidence the CMS report needs.
